title: चमकती मिठाई = चिपचिपा सच! 🍬 | Hullabaloo Cartoon Colony | अंग्रेज़ी कार्टून कॉमेडी
description:
Colony ki sabse chamakti mithai ne sabka dil jeet liya... par ek bite mein sach saamne aata hai! Mithai ki dukaan pe bheed lagi hai, sabke munh mein paani hai, aur gang ne bhi pehla dibba utha liya. But jo dikhta hai woh hamesha sweet nahi hota. Watch how the gang sniffs out the sticky truth in this hilarious family comedy. The lesson: sparkle is not always sugar, so check before you chew! Subscribe to Hullabaloo Cartoon Colony for a brand new episode every week.
